desc.testo: The Progressive Corporation is an American insurance company headquartered in Mayfield, Ohio. It was co-founded in 1937 by Jack Green and Joseph M. Lewis. The company insures passenger vehicles, motorcycles, recreational vehicles (RVs), trailers, boats, personal water craft (PWC), and commercial vehicles.
desc.trad: La Progressive Corporation è una compagnia assicurativa americana con sede a Mayfield, Ohio. È stata co-fondata nel 1937 da Jack Green e Joseph M. Lewis. L'azienda assicura veicoli passeggeri, motocicli, veicoli ricreativi (RV), rimorchi, barche, moto d'acqua (PWC) e veicoli commerciali.
